proposal.thesis: Micron just delivered one of the cleanest beat-and-raise prints in the AI-supplier cohort: Q3 FY26 revenue of $41.5B (guided next quarter to $50B, +20% QoQ) with gross margin at 85% and guided to ~86%, an EPS beat of 24% ($25.11 vs $20.20 est). The company disclosed 16 Strategic Customer Agreements worth roughly $100B of minimum contracted revenue, including $18B of customer cash deposits to secure HBM supply that is sold out through 2026 with demand outstripping supply by 50-67%. Despite the print and today's +12% reaction, the stock still trades at just 5.5-6.8x forward earnings versus a 30.6x semiconductor sector median, and the balance sheet is a fortress (net cash ~$23.75B, debt/equity 0.06, TTM FCF $26.2B). The setup is a post-earnings-drift trade, not a chase into an unresolved binary: the print already happened and the thesis is that the market has not yet re-rated the multiple to reflect the newly-disclosed, quantified demand visibility.
catalysts: Q3 FY26 earnings beat + Q4 FY26 guide to $50B revenue / ~$31 EPS / ~86% gross margin, reported 2026-07-22
16 Strategic Customer Agreements ~$100B minimum contracted revenue incl. $18B cash deposits, disclosed 2026-07-22
HBM capacity sold out through 2026, demand 50-67% above supply per management commentary
Next earnings print ~2026-09-22 (outside this swing's 45-day horizon)
proposal.macro_context: Regime is supportive (SPY 748 vs 694 200-DMA, score 4/5) with cooling Fed funds but a rising 10Y (4.60%) and reaccelerating CPI (3.46% YoY) - a real headwind for richly-multipled growth, but MU trades at 5.5-6.8x forward earnings (82% discount to the 30.6x semis median) so it is one of the least rate-sensitive ways to own the AI buildout. Momentum-factor is flagged 'unwind' at the ETF level (MTUM -8.3% off highs) even though our own 3-month leader cohort (which includes MU) reads 'healthy' - sizing already reflects the code's automatic 0.5x haircut.
proposal.risk_map: Primary risk is that today's post-earnings pop is the whole move (sell-the-news chase) rather than the start of a re-rating drift; memory is a historically boom-bust cyclical and the market may simply not extend the multiple regardless of the backlog. A DRAM/NAND pricing air-pocket, a hyperscaler pausing HBM orders, or a broader semi-sector de-rating (the chips_crack_20 stress scenario) would hit this position hard given its 8.4% ATR. Sized at roughly half the normal risk budget given the momentum-factor unwind flag, and the stop is set at 1.4x ATR (11.8%) to survive ordinary post-earnings volatility, without an options expected-move cross-check since MU was outside this run's deep-research focus set.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Sell-side is already bullish (Strong Buy, KeyBanc $1,750 PT, ~$1,490 mean target) yet MU still trades at just 5.5-6.8x forward earnings, an ~82% discount to the 30.6x semiconductor sector median. MY VIEW: the market is still pricing this as a garden-variety boom-bust memory cycle rather than a structurally-scarce, multi-year HBM supercycle. MECHANISM: today's print disclosed 16 Strategic Customer Agreements worth ~$100B of MINIMUM CONTRACTED revenue, including $18B of customer CASH DEPOSITS to secure supply - a quantified, non-slideware signal of demand visibility that historical memory cycles never had, and which the stock's cyclical-discount multiple has not yet re-rated to reflect even after today's pop. RESOLUTION: the FY26 Q4 print (~2026-09-22, guided $50B revenue / ~$31 EPS / ~86% gross margin) and any HBM4/customer-agreement follow-on news over the next 30-45 days will show whether the backlog converts as guided; if it does, the multiple re-rates further even without new news.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Q4 FY26 report or any pre-announcement showing gross margin guidance walked back below ~80% (vs the ~86% just guided) or bookings/backlog not converting from the disclosed $100B Strategic Customer Agreements would kill this thesis.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close back below $880 (below both the pre-earnings resistance-turned-support zone and roughly the 50-DMA) on above-average volume would show the breakout has failed and the gap is being reversed.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If MU has not sustained a close above $1,050 (meaningful follow-through beyond today's gap) within 30 trading days of entry, the drift thesis is not confirming and the position should be reduced or rotated.
